items.title: Dave Bailey and John McNeil Interview, 1959-10-25
items.q: Clayton, I played a film with him

ctx.x: What brass bands have you worked with?

Well I've worked with the Gibson brass band and that was the only jazz brass band, you know, that I played with outside of the school band when I was coming up with me. And I was, I got a chance to learn quite a bit, think about jazz more than ever. And because I ran into some of the old timers, you know, in that field, like Dave, and he'd give me a lot of ideas and things that I didn't know and he could hum it and I guess, you know, most of that stuff is played by Ed anyway and you catch the, you really get the…
Well he's mighty good, Clayton. Yeah, yeah.
